description: 【篠栗町】指定避難所・指定緊急避難所(福岡都市圏共通フォーマット) [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 篠栗町. 篠栗町の指定避難所・指定緊急避難所のデータセットです。. Coverage: 篠栗町. The portal files it under the publisher 篠栗町. Its tags are 位置情報, 施設, 避難, 避難所, 防災. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, pdf. The portal shows 2019-10-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
